2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 7992C of 2022 dated 13.07.2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 379, 307, 323, 324,
504, 506 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

4. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51519 of 2023(3)
dt.09-11-2023 the co-accused persons are alleged to have tortured the informant mentally and physically due to non-fulfillment of demand of Rs. 1,00,000/- as dowry.
The accused persons including petititoner also ousted the complainant from her matrimonial house.
It has been further alleged that petitioner along with accused Nikku Singh came at the house of the house of the complainant and assaulted her and took away Rs. 2,000/- cash and some documents.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner.

It is further submitted that the complainant never wanted to live with the petitioner and was in relationship with another man namely, Visa Yadav with whom she went to Surat, Gujarat and lives with the said Visa Yadav.
It is further submitted that the complainant has instituted the present false case only to implicate the petitioner and his family members and create pressure upon them.
It is further submitted that the present case has been filed after 10 years of marriage.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of "Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51519 of 2023(3) dt.09-11-2023 Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3)
PLJR 182."

sentences.text: The petitioner has no criminal antecedent as stated in para 3 of the bail petition.
6. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court concerned, Patna in connection with Complaint Case No. 7992C of 2022, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51519 of 2023(3) dt.09-11-2023 subject to conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

8. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
9. The application stands allowed.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) Nilmani/-
